    How to play

    • GOALRun as far as you can. TAP to jump. HOLD to jump higher and to fly through the gates.
    • DANGERJump coyotes, tumbleweeds and cacti. You have 5 lives. Every 700 m is a new world.
    • POWERChile = double jump. Boombox = bass drop. Note = slow-mo. Vinyl = +1 life. A glowing face = a lift.
    • MOVETap anywhere on the game to jump, or press Space. Hold to jump higher and to fly.
